text: Searching PubMed for new randomized trials
Any new colorectal cancer trials published?

entry.text: PubMed: 3767 records match the search; 6 new added to the reading list

text: Free shift: testing her registered hypotheses

hypothesis.text: H001: Many finished colorectal cancer trials have no public results
hypothesis.evidence: Waiting: automated search done (92 of 356 trials, 25.8%, with no results found); the hand-checked sample has not been drawn yet.

hypothesis.text: H002: Results go missing less often since the 2017 US reporting rule
hypothesis.evidence: No results found for 24.4% of trials completed since the 2017 rule (29/119) vs 26.6% before (63/237); one-sided p = 0.376.

hypothesis.text: H003: Industry and non-industry trials differ in missing results
hypothesis.evidence: No results found for 14.7% of industry trials (24/163) vs 35.2% of others (68/193); two-sided p = 1.04e-05. Industry trials less often have no results.

hypothesis.text: H004: Some abstracts report a different primary endpoint than the trial registered
hypothesis.evidence: 0 of 50 trials (0.0%, 95% CI 0.0% to 7.1%) report a different primary endpoint than they registered (code flagged none).

entry.text: Free shift: hypotheses tested: H001 waiting, H002 not_supported, H003 supported, H004 inconclusive
